summary: SKK Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 770,000 Class A Ordinary Shares at $4.46 per share, raising gross proceeds of $3.43 million. Investors paid in USDT, valued using Coinbase as of August 11, 2026. The offering closed on August 17, 2026 under an effective F-3 shelf. Post-closing, the company had 2,875,332 Class A and 1,085,264 Class B shares outstanding. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
